{"people":[{"name":"Renee","role":"account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"interviewer","side":"us"},{"name":"Owen","role":"VP of Product, champion and main contact","side":"customer"},{"name":"Diane","role":"CFO, froze new vendor projects; never spoken to by the rep","side":"customer"},{"name":"Engineering lead","role":"customer engineering lead, unnamed","side":"customer"},{"name":"Guy who left","role":"built the homegrown billing system","side":"other"}],
"competitors":[],
"incumbent":"A homegrown billing system built by someone who has since left",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"There wasn't one big thing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep frames the trigger as diffuse, with no single event."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their VP of Product, Owen, had wanted to rebuild billing for a while.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Long-standing internal desire from the product VP."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"The billing system is homegrown, built by a guy who left, and every pricing change takes them a quarter.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","gaps"],"note":"Incumbent state and pain: a quarter per pricing change."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"He reached out to us.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Inbound interest from Owen."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"He wanted it done before they launched a new pricing tier, but the tier didn't have a date either.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"No hard deadline; urgency was soft."},
{"id":"E6","turn":6,"excerpt":"The CFO, I guess? Diane.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep hedges on who made the final call."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"She froze it. Well, she froze everything.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","decider","outcome"],"note":"Freeze reported secondhand via Owen; rep self-corrects to a blanket freeze."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"They missed their number in Q3 and she put a hold on all new vendor projects.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Stated cause: Q3 miss and hold on all new vendor projects."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"So I don't know that you'd say she decided against us. She decided against everything.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Rep's read that this was not a rejection of us."},
{"id":"E10","turn":8,"excerpt":"Owen told me. I never spoke to her.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"All knowledge of the CFO's decision is secondhand through Owen."},
{"id":"E11","turn":10,"excerpt":"No. Owen said he'd bring her in at the end.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"The decider was never in any meeting; she was to be brought in late."},
{"id":"E12","turn":12,"excerpt":"There wasn't one. It was us against doing nothing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep says no competitor; the real alternative was status quo."},
{"id":"E13","turn":12,"excerpt":"Owen never looked at anybody else, as far as I know.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Hedged with 'as far as I know'; not verified."},
{"id":"E14","turn":14,"excerpt":"Toward the end Owen started asking for things for finance.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","message"],"note":"Customer's questions shifted toward finance justification."},
{"id":"E15","turn":14,"excerpt":"do you have something that shows payback?","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Owen asks for payback evidence; introduced with 'Like,' so close to verbatim."},
{"id":"E16","turn":14,"excerpt":"That started maybe a month before the freeze.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Timing of the shift, hedged with 'maybe'."},
{"id":"E17","turn":16,"excerpt":"Reaction: the billing demo. Changing a price in a few clicks, trials, proration.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The pitch part that landed: the billing demo."},
{"id":"E18","turn":16,"excerpt":"that's a quarter of roadmap in five minutes.","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Owen's reaction to the demo."},
{"id":"E19","turn":16,"excerpt":"His engineers were into it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Engineering enthusiasm for the demo."},
{"id":"E20","turn":16,"excerpt":"I don't know that anything got silence.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep initially says nothing got silence, then names something."},
{"id":"E21","turn":16,"excerpt":"We only ever talked to product and engineering.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","gaps"],"note":"No finance or executive contact through the cycle."},
{"id":"E22","turn":16,"excerpt":"I guess the revenue framing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep's guess at what fell flat."},
{"id":"E23","turn":16,"excerpt":"we're not trying to grow revenue with billing, we're trying to stop it being a tax on the roadmap.","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Owen rejects our revenue-growth framing."},
{"id":"E24","turn":18,"excerpt":"The freeze email.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"The moment the rep felt it would not close."},
{"id":"E25","turn":18,"excerpt":"Before that we were in procurement. Well, we'd sent paper.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","decided"],"note":"Contract paper sent; rep self-corrects from 'in procurement'."},
{"id":"E26","turn":20,"excerpt":"I sent him the ROI deck. The general one, with the study.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Generic ROI deck sent in response to a request for a customer-specific number."},
{"id":"E27","turn":20,"excerpt":"I can't get this past Diane without a number that's ours.","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decider","language"],"note":"Owen needs a customer-specific number to get past the CFO."},
{"id":"E28","turn":20,"excerpt":"We were going to set up a session to build one. Then Q3 closed.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"The ROI-building session never happened before the freeze."},
{"id":"E29","turn":22,"excerpt":"About a month.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"A month between the payback request and the freeze, with no custom number built."},
{"id":"E30","turn":24,"excerpt":"The number. Their own. What the homegrown system costs them.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"The key thing we could not show: the customer's own cost of the status quo."},
{"id":"E31","turn":24,"excerpt":"some landlord subscriptions lapse because the card fails and nobody chases it. We never added it up.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Owen mentioned a revenue-leak cost we never quantified; customers are landlords."},
{"id":"E32","turn":24,"excerpt":"He also asked about migration.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Migration of existing subscriptions without re-collecting cards, in stages."},
{"id":"E33","turn":24,"excerpt":"we don't touch billing before renewal season.","label":"quote","speaker":"Customer engineering lead","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","trigger"],"note":"Engineering timing constraint that adds another reason for delay."},
{"id":"E34","turn":24,"excerpt":"We had a doc for that. He wanted to talk to someone who'd done it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Migration answered with a doc; Owen wanted a reference customer."},
{"id":"E35","turn":26,"excerpt":"a tax on the roadmap.","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Owen's own words for the problem."},
{"id":"E36","turn":26,"excerpt":"if it isn't on fire, it isn't funded.","label":"quote","speaker":"Diane, via Owen","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","decider"],"note":"CFO's stance as relayed by Owen, not heard directly."},
{"id":"E37","turn":26,"excerpt":"Owen said finance saw it as a nice to have.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","decider"],"note":"Finance's view as reported by Owen."},
{"id":"E38","turn":28,"excerpt":"For Owen, yeah. For Diane, no.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","gaps"],"note":"Rep's read on urgency for each person."},
{"id":"E39","turn":28,"excerpt":"I don't think anyone told her what it was costing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decider"],"note":"Rep guesses the CFO never saw the cost of the status quo."},
{"id":"E40","turn":30,"excerpt":"It's timing. It'll come back next year.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","decided"],"note":"Rep's prediction; unsupported by customer statements."},
{"id":"E41","turn":30,"excerpt":"I don't think there was anything we could have done.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","gaps"],"note":"Conflicts with the unbuilt ROI number and no finance access."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E41","E30","E28"],"what":"Rep says nothing could have been done, yet describes a missing customer-specific payback number and a session never held to build it."},
{"evidence":["E41","E21","E39"],"what":"Rep says nothing could have been done, yet we only talked to product and engineering and the CFO was probably never told the cost."},
{"evidence":["E20","E22","E23"],"what":"Rep says nothing got silence, then names the revenue framing, which Owen explicitly rejected."},
{"evidence":["E6","E7","E9"],"what":"Rep calls Diane the decider with a hedge, says she froze it, then doubts she decided against us."},
{"evidence":["E25","E11","E10"],"what":"Rep says paper was sent and procurement reached, but the CFO never joined a meeting and the rep never spoke to her."},
{"evidence":["E12","E1","E8"],"what":"Rep says there was no single trigger and no date, yet the outcome hinged on a Q3 miss and freeze."},
{"evidence":["E40","E33","E5"],"what":"Rep says it is timing and will return next year, while the customer also cited a renewal-season no-touch constraint and no firm date."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"Who made the final call, and how do you know?","turn":6,"what":"Answered 'The CFO, I guess?' and conceded the knowledge is secondhand via Owen with no direct CFO contact."},
{"question":"Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?","turn":16,"what":"Said 'I don't know that anything got silence,' then offered the revenue framing as a guess."},
{"question":"Anything else?","turn":30,"what":"Closed with 'nothing we could have done,' contradicted by the gaps described earlier."},
{"question":"Was it on fire?","turn":28,"what":"Answered with a split between Owen and Diane, based on assumption about what Diane was told."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"a tax on the roadmap","ours":"growing revenue","evidence":["E23","E35"]},
{"theirs":"a number that's ours","ours":"the general ROI deck with the study","evidence":["E27","E26"]},
{"theirs":"something that shows payback","ours":"ROI deck","evidence":["E15","E26"]},
{"theirs":"nice to have / if it isn't on fire, it isn't funded","ours":"billing rebuild as a strategic or revenue investment","evidence":["E36","E37","E23"]},
{"theirs":"a quarter of roadmap in five minutes","ours":"changing a price in a few clicks, trials, proration","evidence":["E18","E17"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E7","E8"],"what":"No decision: the CFO froze all new vendor projects after a Q3 miss; not a competitive loss."},
{"evidence":["E25","E24"],"what":"Paper had been sent before the freeze email arrived."},
{"evidence":["E12"],"what":"No competitor; the alternative was doing nothing."},
{"evidence":["E40"],"what":"Rep expects it to come back next year; this is her prediction, not customer-stated."},
{"evidence":["E28","E29"],"what":"The ROI-building session never occurred before the freeze, about a month after the payback ask."},
{"evidence":["E9"],"what":"No part of the business moved; the freeze applied to everything, not just us."}
]}

contradictions.what: Rep says nothing could have been done, yet describes a missing customer-specific payback number and a session never held to build it.
Rep says nothing could have been done, yet we only talked to product and engineering and the CFO was probably never told the cost.
Rep says nothing got silence, then names the revenue framing, which Owen explicitly rejected.
Rep calls Diane the decider with a hedge, says she froze it, then doubts she decided against us.
Rep says paper was sent and procurement reached, but the CFO never joined a meeting and the rep never spoke to her.
Rep says there was no single trigger and no date, yet the outcome hinged on a Q3 miss and freeze.
Rep says it is timing and will return next year, while the customer also cited a renewal-season no-touch constraint and no firm date.
